decision_scope: One causally distinct documentary L0 using the same new SEC note already acquired for A-E admission. No admitted A-E event was established; this is not a claim that no qualifying event exists. The L0 is not a return rejection, a promotion or a new economic look.
RESULT: Public primary financing terms are accessible and distinguish optional/conditional conversion from deterministic calendar supply. Actual conversion exercise, issuance and onward sale are not established on a usable public clock; PARK_DATA before L1.
EFFECT_SIZE: NOT_COMPUTED; contractual95% conversion factor is not an observed profit or a payoff to common shareholders.
UNCERTAINTY: Only one legal instrument reviewed, selected through a reverse-split keyword match, not an unbiased financing-event sample. Actual notices, lender decisions, borrower cash choices, conversion, selling and borrow/execution costs unobserved. Public availability of the contract does not establish public real-time notices.
POWER_LIMITATION: No price, conversion-realization or return sample. A single contract can contradict a universal forced-monthly-flow assumption but cannot estimate a financing-pressure premium.
ECONOMIC_SIGNIFICANCE: A financing-constrained issuer can compensate a secured lender through conversion rights/discounts; existing shareholders may bear dilution. Potential lender resale could create inventory pressure, but choice, credit risk, endogenous share prices and borrowing frictions can explain/remove any secondary-market opportunity. Buying the common stock does not transfer note-holder rights.
FAILED_CRITERIA: Section3.1: ordinary fixed redemptions start after12months and require a lender notice at its discretion; cash, shares or a mix are borrower options, subject to conditions. No deterministic monthly share delivery follows from the label Fixed Redemptions.

Section2 provides a distinct conditional limited-redemption share-delivery route; it must not be erased when describing optional ordinary redemption. Trigger/exercise/Exchange Cap and other conditions remain unobserved.
A11 makes the limited-redemption trigger depend on contemporaneous prices. Treating it as an exogenous calendar shock would be invalid.
No public point-in-time exercise/actual-issuance/sale clock or viable short-borrow/execution route established in the permitted documents.
LESSON: Separate financing announcement, contingent conversion entitlement, actual lender exercise, share issuance and sale. The note supports a possible conditional flow mechanism; it falsifies a mechanical monthly-sale shortcut and does not give a retail common shareholder the contractual lender discount.
FAMILY_STATUS: PARK_DATA at L0; untested, no economic family activated, no alpha inference

mechanism.who_pays: Issuer purchasing financing/liquidity; dilution may be borne by existing shareholders. The secured lender supplies capital and bears contractual/credit/execution risks. Secondary-market pressure would require actual issuance and sale.
mechanism.why_persist: Financing frictions and limited risk-bearing capital could support contractual compensation, while share borrow/liquidity risk may limit outsiders. Persistence and capture are hypotheses, not findings.
mechanism.distinctness: Negotiated secured-financing optionality/supply differs from fractional-share corporate-action settlement, SPAC trust redemption and lockup permission. Possible common liquidity-risk dependence remains; no independent-trial claim or reset.
mechanism.accessible_primary_data: SEC index and full public note successfully retrieved without key/account/payment. Only documentary terms are qualified; future event or price availability not asserted.
mechanism.discriminated_question: Can this public note by itself define an exogenous deterministic share-supply schedule for a cheap L1? No: choices, price-contingent trigger and unobserved notices break that clock. An announcement-only hypothesis would be a separate declaration, not a silent proxy substitution.

primary_passages.quote: Beginning on the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Purchase Price Date, Lender shall have the right, exercisable at any time in its sole and absolute discretion ... by providing Borrower with a notice
primary_passages.implication: Eligibility date is not actual exercise/date of share issuance.

primary_passages.quote: Payments ... may be made, in Borrower’s discretion, (a) in cash, (b) by converting ... or (c) by any combination of the foregoing
primary_passages.implication: Ordinary redemption does not force common-share supply.

primary_passages.quote: if ... a Limited Redemption Event occurs, Lender shall have the right to submit ... a conversion notice ... Borrower must pay ... by delivery ... of ... Common Shares
primary_passages.implication: There is also a conditional share-delivery path; no claim that all conversion is borrower-optional. Cap/other exceptions preserved.

primary_passages.quote: Common Shares trade at a price that is at least ten percent (10%) greater than the Market Price for such Trading Day
primary_passages.implication: Trigger is endogenous to market prices, not a predetermined independent supply date; no actual trigger checked.

primary_passages.quote: Conversion Price ... means ninety-five percent (95%) of the Market Price on the applicable measurement date
primary_passages.implication: Contractual note-holder term; no realized profit inference or public-share entitlement.
